proposed_ledger_entry: Item 339 attacks the actual selected fixed-j1 factor b_h on the true row, rather than adding another carrier. With n=2h, r=2s+1, p=2n+3r and 2M=3n+4r, unit-branch Frobenius proves b_h=[t^n]F(t)^(-r) mod p. The integral normalization a_(r,n)=2^n[t^n]F^(-r)=[u^n]G(u)^(-r), G=(1-u)^4-u^4, has the exact positive prefix sum_k C(r+k-1,k)C(4r+n-1,n-4k) and the fixed rational bivariate carrier zG/(G^2-z^2). Lucas gives a complete termwise classification: every summand is p-divisible iff r=n+1 and n=2 mod 4, equivalently h=s odd. This forced carrier-zero ray has at most one row at fixed M and O(log M)=o(M) mass. Outside it, surviving-unit cancellation remains possible; the preselected (h,s,p)=(8,2,47) row has five unit terms summing to zero. For fixed r the exact reduced generating function G^(-r) has minimal constant-coefficient recurrence order 3r=6s+3. At fixed M, sublinear direct recurrence rank and sublinear survivor length each occupy candidate-prime intervals of total length o(M), hence have weighted mass o(M). Thus direct termwise-carry, bounded/sublinear-tail, and bounded/sublinear-rank local recurrence methods cannot control positive-rate bulk. The open input is uniform mod-p cancellation/nonconcentration, average gcd, factor localization for the fixed rational carrier, or a different gate-forcing global trace. Booking and ceiling reduction remain zero; the fixed-j1 ceiling remains 1/36 per 6M.
